title: Accounts Executive
description:
Location: Coimbatore (Onsite) Experience: 2 - 4 years (Hands-on) 
 
 Job Summary 
 Were looking for a hands-on Accounts Executive who can independently manage day-to-day bookkeeping, compliance, and reporting for a growing consulting firm serving global clients. Youll work closely with leadership to keep the books accurate, compliance timelines met, and financial reporting audit-ready. Youll take ownership of the full accounting cycle-from transaction entry to PL and balance sheet reporting-while coordinating statutory filings and payroll-related compliance across multiple organizations/entities under our umbrella. If youre detail-oriented, dependable, and comfortable owning numbers end-to-end, this role is for you. Were a firm thats constantly picking up new tools, so youll fit right in if you enjoy figuring out a better, faster way to do something rather than sticking to the same process out of habit. Given that youll be handling sensitive financials across multiple entities, this is a role built on trust - someone we can hand the numbers to and not have to double-check. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Maintain books of accounts for multiple entities/organizations in parallel, keeping each set of records distinct and audit-ready. Maintain day-to-day bookkeeping and ledgers in Zoho Books . Perform regular expense reconciliations (bank, vendor, and credit card). Prepare and maintain the Chart of Accounts . Prepare PL statements, Balance Sheets, projections, and budgets for management review. Track and report on cash flow , flagging shortfalls or timing gaps proactively. Process payroll accurately and on time, including statutory deductions. Maintain Asset Management records (fixed assets, depreciation schedules). Handle GST and TDS computation, payment, and return filing (including quarterly TDS filings). Ensure compliance with Professional Tax, PF, Gratuity, and Shop Establishment registrations and renewals. Support Income Tax related filings and coordination with auditors/consultants. Manage client and vendor invoicing , including follow-up on outstanding receivables. Handle multi-currency transactions (USD billing) and reconcile FX conversions. Support audit requirements by preparing schedules and responding to auditor queries. Keep records in Zoho Books clean and consistent, so reports and dashboards stay reliable. Use AI tools to improve accuracy and speed of recurring accounting tasks. Maintain clear, professional written communication with internal teams, vendors, and clients over email. 
 
 Early Impact 
 Weeks 1-2: Understand our accounting systems, chart of accounts, compliance calendar, and ongoing processes. By ~60 days: Independently manage bookkeeping, reconciliations, and routine compliance filings with minimal supervision. By ~90 days: Own the monthly close process end-to-end, including PL/Balance Sheet preparation, and proactively flag compliance deadlines, cash flow gaps, and budget variances before theyre asked about. 
 
 Must-haves 
 2-4 years of hands-on experience in Accounting and Bookkeeping. Proven experience managing books for multiple organizations/entities simultaneously , keeping each set of accounts separate and accurate. Strong working knowledge of Zoho Books (or equivalent accounting software). Proficiency in Excel (formulas, reconciliations, reporting). Practical experience with GST and TDS compliance, including quarterly TDS filings. Experience preparing PL statements, Balance Sheets, projections, and budgets . Good understanding of cash flow - tracking inflows/outflows and anticipating shortfalls. Experience maintaining a Chart of Accounts . Experience with payroll processing and statutory deductions. Experience with Asset Management (fixed asset tracking, depreciation). Working knowledge of Professional Tax, PF, Gratuity, and Shop Establishment compliance. Comfort using AI tools to support accounting workflows. Strong written communication skills, especially over email. Someone who takes ownership of the numbers, follows through without needing reminders, and is comfortable being the person others can rely on when it matters. 
 
 Good to Have 
 Prior experience in a consulting or services firm billing international clients. Exposure to Income Tax filings and audit coordination. Experience working directly with external auditors, CAs, or compliance consultants. Experience handling client/vendor invoicing and receivables follow-up. Exposure to multi-currency accounting , particularly USD billing and FX reconciliation. 
 
 Skills 
 Zoho Books Excel AI Tools GST TDS Income Tax Bookkeeping Multi-Entity Accounting Expense Reconciliations PL Balance Sheets Cash Flow Projections Budgets Chart of Accounts Payroll Processing Asset Management Professional Tax PF Gratuity Shop Establishment Compliance Client Vendor Invoicing Multi-Currency Accounting Audit Support Written Communication 
 
 Educational Qualifications 
 We care more about the quality of your work and thinking than specific degrees. A strong track record in similar roles matters most.

title: Export Lead
description:
Job Summary 
 International Business Development 
 
 Responsibilities 
 
 International Business Development 
 Identify and develop new international markets, customers, distributors, and business opportunities. Generate leads and build a strong pipeline of international prospects. Develop market entry strategies based on market trends, customer needs, competition, and business potential. Conduct competitor and market analysis to identify growth opportunities. Drive export sales and achieve international revenue targets. Prepare and deliver product presentations, quotations, proposals, and commercial negotiations. Build and maintain strong relationships with overseas customers, distributors, agents, and channel partners. Explore opportunities for new products, markets, and distribution channels. 
 
 Export Operations Compliance 
 Manage export operations, including order processing, documentation, shipment coordination, and logistics. Ensure compliance with international trade regulations, customs requirements, export policies, and Incoterms. Prepare and verify commercial invoices, packing lists, certificates of origin, shipping bills, and other export documents. Coordinate with production, warehouse, logistics, finance, and sales teams to ensure timely order fulfilment. Liaise with freight forwarders, shipping lines, customs brokers, and relevant government authorities. Track shipments and proactively resolve delays, documentation issues, and logistics challenges. 
 
 Business Performance Management 
 Monitor export sales, margins, customer profitability, and market performance. Track export costs and identify opportunities for cost optimisation and process improvement. Maintain accurate customer, sales, shipment, and export records. Prepare regular reports on sales pipeline, market development, order status, and export performance for management. Lead and mentor the export/business development team and drive performance. International sales and revenue growth. New international customers/distributors acquired. New markets/countries developed. Lead-to-customer conversion. Customer retention and repeat business. Export order fulfilment and on-time shipment performance. Export margins and cost optimisation.
